correctness.rationale: The join Laplacian diagonalizes into global constant (eigenvalue 0), clique/residual contrast and clique zero-sum (eigenvalue n), and residual zero-sum (kI+L_H). Exact blocks give clique–residual entries (1−F_p(nh))/n, necessary and strictly negative for h>β_p/n by strict convexity F_p=F_(p−2)>0. Residual block = F_p(h(kI+L_H))+q(h)J with q≥0 by Jensen, strictly >0 for h>0. Under n≥β_p(k+Δ) and h≤β_p/n, put B=ΔI−L_H≥0 and s=h(k+Δ)≤1; Taylor expansion ∑ h^j F_(p−j)(s)B^j/j! has nonnegative coefficients, proving sufficiency. p even and scalar positivity ensure unique β crossing. Independently computed rational 4th-order matrix on K1∨P7 at t=nh=1,2 and above β at 3, matching block signs, not an all-graph exhaustive test.
